units.source_text: 季节诵经开始了，明石皇后便回东所去。

en.t: When the seasonal sutra recitations began, Empress Akashi returned to the eastern quarters.

units.source_text: 三皇子在许多弟兄中长得最为可爱，此时常在各处闲步。

en.t: Among all his many brothers, the Third Prince was the loveliest, and at this time he often wandered idly from place to place.

units.source_text: 紫夫人精神好转之时，叫他到面前来，

en.t: When Lady Murasaki felt a little better, she called him to her side,

units.source_text: 乘无人听见，便问他：“我倘死了，你想念我么？”

en.t: and, taking a moment when no one could hear, asked him, “If I died, would you miss me?”

units.source_text: 三皇子答道：“一定会想念。

en.t: The Third Prince answered, “Of course I would miss you.

units.source_text: 我同外婆最好，比皇上和皇后还好。

en.t: I am closest to Grandmother, even closer than to His Majesty and the Empress.

units.source_text: 外婆倘没有了，我真不高兴。”

en.t: If Grandmother were gone, I would be truly unhappy.”

units.source_text: 他用手擦擦眼睛，借以掩饰泪痕。

en.t: He rubbed his eyes with his hand, trying to hide the traces of tears.

units.source_text: 紫夫人脸上显出微笑，一面流下泪来，

en.t: A smile appeared on Lady Murasaki’s face, even as tears fell from her eyes,

units.source_text: 又对他说：“你长大起来，就住在这屋子里。

en.t: and she said to him again, “When you grow up, live in this room.

units.source_text: 每逢这庭前的红梅和樱树开花的时候，你要用心爱护它们。

en.t: Whenever the red plum and cherry trees before this garden bloom, take good care of them with all your heart.

units.source_text: 有机会时，折几枝来供在佛前。”

en.t: When you have the chance, break off a few branches and offer them before the Buddha.”

units.source_text: 三皇子点点头，望着紫夫人的面孔，

en.t: The Third Prince nodded and gazed at Lady Murasaki’s face,

units.source_text: 觉得眼泪要流出来了，便回转身，走了开去。

en.t: but when he felt tears about to spill out, he turned around and walked away.

units.source_text: 这三皇子和大公主，是紫夫人特别用心抚育长大的，

en.t: This Third Prince and the First Princess had been raised with special care by Lady Murasaki,

units.source_text: 她不能亲见他们成人立业，不胜惋惜悲伤。

en.t: and she was deeply grieved and full of regret that she would not live to see them grow up and make their way in the world.
